normal.coordinates: Center longitude 180 and origin easting zero. Raster x increases eastward from 180 E. Shared GeoTIFF preparation derives a half-width roll from this actual origin.
normal.downloadCorrection: Catalog mistakenly links the older Rhea_Voyager_mosaic_global_833m.tif. Use the pinned Cassini_Voyager 417m file, whose metadata matches the catalog dimensions, projection radius and pixel size.

enhanced.coordinates: 0 E left edge, north up. Independent crater positions match after rolling Monochrome.
enhanced.processing: Published radiometric calibration, geographic registration and photometric correction by Paul Schenk. Preserve real hemisphere differences, source seams and residual photographed shading.

elevation.accuracy: Producer estimates typical global DTM uncertainty at 2.15–4.3 km.
elevation.processing: Honor actual GeoTIFF bounds; bilinear interpolation inside source cells and northwest relief at true height scale. No edge extrapolation.
elevation.notSelected: The secondary relative-albedo model is coarser than the observations and its producer documents topography and shadow leakage; not added as a redundant lens.

shape.rendering: Mean-radius sphere from astronomy package; elevation is visualized on the texture. No visible halo for the extremely tenuous exosphere; no unconfirmed rings.
